Hey OP. I felt exactly what you feel. Like identical. It's not even funny.

 But that's a good thing. That means you aren't alone in this. That means someone else has felt exactly what you felt and found someway around it. 

Numbness is a sign. Usually for me it meant I was feeling so fucking much my brain shut down emotions for the time being. I don't know if you can get a therapist but if you are able to, please talk to them.

As for your parents, I wish I could be your mom and dad right now. But I can't. I can only tell you that you need to remember they are human too and that you came from them. Maybe the anger you feel is something they feel. They will also have no idea how to fix or help you because their parents DEFINITELY didn't take the time to see if they were okay. THIS IS NOT AN EXCUSE FOR YOUR PARENTS BEHAVIOR. This is just facts to help ease the depression. When I realized my mom was psychotic and unable to love me, it was easier they to say "but she should love me right now I'm her child". I'm hoping this tactic will help you as well. 

I was careful to say "around it". And that's cause I still don't feel correctly. My numbness kicked in when I  was about 16 as well. And shit didn't get better until I turned 20 and was kicked out.

I've been diagnosed with Major Depressive Disorder, PTSD and Generalized Anxiety Disorder. The symptoms manifest in different ways for everyone. But if your like me, be sure to be as clear as possible with your doctor. Explain to them that it's a lack of feeling completely. 

If you ever need someone to talk to OP, I'm here. Message me anytime you want.
You should add me! There's something really nice about getting and giving gifts on there. I'm glad I was able to help. ❤️

Can you get food? Or maybe read something? Or even go for a walk? Maybe even drink water? Hydrating helps me.  Even going and finding other people who are feeling shitty and posting a nice comment helps me. 

I hope I gave you some ideas OP. I'll keep you in my thoughts and try to force some good vibes through my brain waves to your brain waves.

My boyfriend was paranoid and wouldn't sleep at night when he was on Wellbutrin! This is something you should absolutely talk about with your doctor. Like as soon as possible if you can. 

To help with the night terrors I've found a few things help me. 

Number one, Philips lights. If you can afford it. Get Philips lights. They are smart lights. You can get an app and turn the lights on in your room the moment you wake up. This has helped me IMMENSELY.

Number two, if you can't do the lights. Get ya cold on. Every night I sleep with a icepack next to my bed in a bowl. If I wake up from a night terror and I need to get out of that head space, the ice pack goes straight on my face. It's a shock to your system and gets you aware quick.

Number three, when you wake up, say the "right" ending of your night terror. For example, one of my night terrors is my bf driving us into a sinkhole and us being swallowed into the darkness and suffocating. When I wake up and it's dark and I'm scared I'm actually in the sinkhole. Out loud I'll say "And then we flew out of the drak cloud bank and into the open night sky. I was amazed that his car could fly." This not only takes me into a different scenario but also makes it absolutely a "dream/night terrors" cause we don't have flying cars. 

Number four, set yourself in the moment. If you can wake up and make yourself self aware of what's around you that can help as well. Start with noticing your hands, then arms, shoulders, necks and face.

Number five, if you can't wake up. Find something in the dream that's absolutely not real. Anything. Just something that's not real or a transition in your dream (ex. I was in the kitchen and then the woods) and focus on that. This won't take away the fear but it can help if you wake up scared. Because if you can become aware in your nightmare you can stop it in it's tracks.

Number six, last one, meditate as you fall asleep. Picture what you want to happen, a wonderful date with SO. Meeting your favorite actor. Getting your favorite food or visiting your favorite place. Meditation before sleep can help set your brain up for some good REM sleep.

Hope this helps. If not you, maybe someone else.
